Implements complex communications and network system changes. Participates in the configuration and testing of complex network diagnostic tools and software. (20% time)

Responsible for general network issue determination and resolution. Troubleshoots complex issues in network systems software and distribution and access electronics for medium and large network installations. Works directly with vendor/manufacturer technical support to isolate and resolve complex hardware and software issues. Configures and troubleshoots systems that support network services. (20% time)
Identifies and selects training opportunities for professional development. Participates in cross-functional group discussions, activities and efforts. (20% time)

Coordinates all phases of multiple, complex network projects: planning, design, procurement, implementation and documentation. Consults with other units on new or retrofit building projects and to provide advice and guidance on communications infrastructure. (20% time)

Performs complex analysis and takes a lead role in the design, specification and installation of distribution and access electronics. Evaluates and tests new or enhanced electronics and services. Provides expert advice to users/units on communication needs. (15% time)
Responsible for documenting Root Cause Analysis (RCA) after a service outage or disruptive event, incorporating automated telemetry and diagnostic tooling where available. (5% time)

Demonstrated thorough knowledge of professional communications and network concepts necessary to resolve issues using established parameters, creativity and independent judgment, escalating as necessary.

Thorough understanding of various network hardware platforms, network related protocols and software including understanding of OSI layer 3 protocols at a basic level and layer 2 protocols at a complex level and related technical standards critical to the operation of interconnected networks.
In-depth experience with network diagnostic and performance management tools and software.
Thorough and broad knowledge and experience working with network management systems.
Ability to gather, organize and analyze data in the completion of a variety of functional assignments.
Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines.
Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team.
Demonstrated diverse problem-solving skills.
Able to support Network WAN/LAN infrastructure and maintain Enterprise networking services such as (VPN, NAC, routers, switches, wireless infrastructure).
Able to monitor, maintain and upgrade network equipment. Provide Tier 3 network support and troubleshoot with Network Engineering and Operation team with limited supervision.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills to build and foster partnerships with customers, technical teams, and management in an audience-friendly manner.
Demonstrated attention to details, practical problem solving abilities, ability to proactively identify opportunities and quickly implement solutions.
Able to work independently and has the desire to learn and share knowledge with team members.

Strong team player with excellent customer service skills along with a demonstrated commitment to service excellence, quality and client communication. Adhere to our mission of "Enabling Customer Success."
Aware of best practices in Information Technology service delivery such as ITIL.

Working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Linux networking systems, Microsoft Active Directory, Office 365, DNS, WINS, SSL VPN, IPSEC VPN, and standards such as Ethernet, LAN, WAN, VoIP, UDP, TCP/IP, 802.1x
Ability to exercise sound judgement and make decisions within scope of the position.

Working knowledge of, or demonstrated ability to quickly develop, network automation and configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible) and Git-based version control workflows, in support of Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
Ability to read, execute, and, with growing proficiency, modify or author automation playbooks and scripts used for network configuration and remediation.
